description: This file is a BitBake include (.inc) file used in building the X.Org X server within a Yocto Project/OpenEmbedded build system. It specifies package metadata, dependencies, configuration options, file placements, and build instructions for the xorg-xserver component.

methods.name: populate_packages
methods.description: A function that dynamically determines the ABI versions of video and input subsystems by invoking pkg-config and appends these as runtime provides for dependency management.
